name: open-meteo-weather
title: Current weather (Open-Meteo)
description: Current temperature, conditions and wind for the place you mention (or your home city), from Open-Meteo's free forecast API. No key needed.
author: civicbot catalog

terms.notes: Free for non-commercial use under 10,000 calls/day; commercial use needs an Open-Meteo API plan.

replies: {location.text}: {temp|round}°F (feels like {feels|round}°F), {code|wmo}, wind {wind|round} mph at {at|time_hm}. Data: Open-Meteo
Weather for {location.text} at {at|time_hm}: {code|wmo}, {temp|round}°F, feels {feels|round}°F, wind {wind|round} mph. (Open-Meteo)
